notes: Form 1040 line 11a v2 (Track 0 T0-8, docs/phases/engine-breadth/milestones/f1098e-student-loan-interest-agi.md): adjusted gross income, corrected from v1's bare passthrough of total income to the printed form's real formula, 'Subtract line 10 from line 9' -- total income minus Schedule 1 line 26 total adjustments. Requires tax.us.2025.income.total-income and tax.us.2025.schedule1.line26-total-adjustments DIRECTLY, not through the new tax.us.2025.income.line10-adjustments symbol minted by rule.form1040-line10.json for the line-10 form-field's own use. This deliberately departs from the line-8/line-9 precedent shape (where line 9 reads line 8's minted symbol, not Schedule 1's own) because T0-8's settlement text and the Track 0 authority-lifecycle table both name total-income and schedule1.line26-total-adjustments explicitly as tax.us.2025.income.agi's two dependencies; routing AGI through line10-adjustments would be an unforced extra derivation hop this milestone's own settlement did not specify. Publishes the same tax.us.2025.income.agi symbol as v1 (unchanged meaning), so rule.form1040-line15.v2 and everything downstream of AGI is preserved unchanged, unpinned, and unretouched per SLI-C8. v1 remains historical, untouched, and reachable through prior package versions -- ordinary rule succession within a package version bump (Ontology Sec 7 derivation-edge displacement), never the migration-artifact machinery of ADR-0063, because income.agi is a derived symbol with no standing findings of its own to retire.
